def equation(t, P, params):
    g = 1-np.exp(-params[0]*t)
    I = params[1] + params[2]*g + params[3]*t*(1-g)
    return I + params[4]*P*t + params[5]*P**2 + params[6]*P**2*t + params[7]*P**3*g + params[8]*P**3*t + params[9]*P*g
